facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 68°F at pass elevation.
No new snow measured at the 1 nearby station in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left Ostrander Lake (8,200 ft) and White Wolf (7,900 ft) 20 to 22 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Ostrander Lake
evidence.detail: left May 8; earlier seasons: June 24 (2023), May 28 (2024), May 17 (2025)

evidence.name: White Wolf
evidence.detail: left May 1; earlier seasons: June 21 (2023), May 23 (2024), May 12 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Ostrander Lake (8,200 ft) and White Wolf (7,900 ft).

evidence.name: Ostrander Lake
evidence.detail: 11.0 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 91.3 in (2023), 41.3 in (2024), 33.9 in (2025)

evidence.name: White Wolf
evidence.detail: 3.8 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 75.4 in (2023), 33.4 in (2024), 30.5 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 29 and May 20, carried from the melt-out dates at Ostrander Lake (8,200 ft) and White Wolf (7,900 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Ostrander Lake
evidence.detail: melted out May 8, 723 ft above the pass; points to March 29 to May 22

evidence.name: White Wolf
evidence.detail: melted out May 1, 423 ft above the pass; points to March 30 to May 18
